newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady, light test- USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market steady, light test- USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a light test, compared with Friday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow to moderate. Demand moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings light and current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 69.50-70.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1200 lbs 70.00.
